newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes easier after range trading.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes easier after range trading.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed slightly lower after moving in a tight range due to a slack overseas dollar and low local demand, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.52, after opening at 57.47. The rupee closed at 57.49 on Tuesday.
"There was a very low level of interest in the forex market due to little commecial demand and a lack of speculation," said an ABN Amro Bank dealer.
Call rates closed at 17.5 percent after opening at 14 percent, due to a big state bank borrowing, dealers said.
